prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on your situation (individual vs. employer group, Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, budget, preferred doctors). A few quick questions will let me give a targeted recommendation:

- Are you looking for individual/family ACA plans, Medicare (Part D/Medicare Advantage), Medicaid/CHIP, or a small‑group/employer plan?
- Do you live on the Kansas or Missouri side of Kansas City (zip code)?
- Do you already have preferred doctors/hospitals or prescriptions that must be covered?

While you answer, here’s a quick, practical way to find a very good broker and what to ask them:

How to find reputable brokers
- Use official resources: Kansas Insurance Department (insurance.kansas.gov) or Missouri Department of Commerce & Insurance (insurance.mo.gov) — both let you verify licenses and check complaints.
- Use NAHU’s “Find an Agent” (nahu.org) or Medicare.gov’s broker finder for Medicare help.
- Ask friends/colleagues or your primary care office for local broker referrals.
- Look for independent brokers (not captive to one carrier) so you can compare multiple carriers.

What to check before you hire them
- License and standing (verify with state DOI).
- Whether they’re independent or tied to one insurer.
- Their experience with your plan type and with Kansas City networks.
- How they’re paid (commissions vs. flat fee) and whether that affects recommendations.
- Whether they provide ongoing help (claims, renewals, plan changes) or only enrollment.
- References or reviews from local clients.

Questions to ask a broker
- Which carriers and plans do you recommend for someone with my needs and why?
- Do you know which local hospitals/doctors are in these plans’ networks?
- How do you handle prescription coverage and formulary checks?
- Will you handle claims/appeals and ongoing support? Any extra fees?
- Can you show a 1‑year cost comparison (premiums + estimated out‑of‑pocket) for 2–3 options?
- Can you provide references from Kansas City clients?

If you want, tell me your plan type and ZIP code and I’ll find several licensed Kansas City brokers (or brokerages) with good local reputations and provide a short comparison.
